web.scope: All 86 retained upstream PNGs reviewed as thumbnails; nine representative originals including NAV and all three 1024px variants.
limitations: Synthetic demo data and explicit review/blocked/unavailable states are retained.
Internal scroll regions limit lower content; this is captured viewport evidence, not complete workflow acceptance.
The retained local rerender has no matching raw manifest, so visual review does not establish recorded browser URL or exact capture time.
The 1024px Ledger and Trading images show the initial horizontal table viewport; right-side columns remain outside it.
NAV axis labels remain small and crowded.

nativeCatalog.scope: All 98 current-main PNG thumbnails plus Accounting Configure, Trading Shell, Data Shell, Evidence Workbench and Report Run Status originals.
limitations: Native 1044 x 788 frames retain lower black bands and right/lower toolbar/banner clipping; the Trading welcome banner reduces usable viewport.
Configure is not loaded; Data Shell shows Loading/Refreshing; Evidence Workbench remains unloaded/circuit-open; Trading has no active workflow.
Reporting Run Status and Dashboard share DashboardPage with Strategy Operations content; this is shared-view implementation evidence, not full route-function acceptance.
The matching upstream artifact does not retain raw observed page/frame markers; requested navigation tags are recorded separately.

nativeManuals.scope: All 27 November 15 native manual captures reviewed as two contact sheets. Strategy Workspace (overview step 03), DataShell (data step 01), PositionBlotter (strategy/trading step 06), and Settings (accounting step 06) also reviewed as original PNGs. Declared and visible page identity, original capture intervals and PNG quality mechanically validated for every capture.
limitations: Native Windows synthetic fixture states do not demonstrate live providers, successful business actions, production-data accuracy or authorization enforcement.
Welcome banners reduce the initial viewports; lower black capture bands, clipped right/lower content and truncated toolbar text remain.
DataShell shows Loading/Refreshing. Empty and selection-required trading and fund views remain visible; these are captured states rather than workflow or product acceptance.
Settings retains unavailable activation and a low-contrast Quick Reference. Contact-sheet review with four original-size inspections does not establish keyboard or assistive-technology behavior.
